name: vinui-monorepo
description: VinUI: a free, open-source UI component library for HTML, React, Vue and Svelte, with blocks and charts, in 8 styles.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @vinui/styles && npm run build -w @vinui/docs
scripts.deploy: npm run build && node scripts/wp-export.mjs && node scripts/keep-assets.mjs && cd workers/site && npx wrangler deploy
scripts.dev: npm run build -w @vinui/styles && npm run dev -w @vinui/docs
